messages.author: 083f9a20ea497ac5
messages.subject: "infinite or missing values in 'x'"
parts:
GenomicSEM Creators,

Thank you for our continued support and sharpening of this software tool!

I just ran into this error and haven't been able to find an existing solution yet.

When I run

pfactor <- commonfactorGWAS(covstruc = LDSCoutput, SNPs = p_sumstats, estimation = "DWLS", cores = NULL, toler = FALSE, SNPSE = 0.005, parallel = TRUE, Output = NULL)

I run into the following error:
# Error in { : task 144586 failed - "infinite or missing values in 'x'"
# Calls: commonfactorGWAS -> %dopar% -> <Anonymous>

Might you have any ideas as to how I can fix this?

Thanks,
Chris

messages.author: 083f9a20ea497ac5
messages.subject: Re: "infinite or missing values in 'x'"
parts: I now think that this error is coming from the fact that one of my summary stats files had a few "Inf" (infinite) values for standard error.  Hopefully filtering these SNPs from that file will fix that downstream error.

messages.author: 083f9a20ea497ac5
messages.subject: Re: "infinite or missing values in 'x'"
parts:
Andrew,

Thanks for following up with me.  This filtering of the "Inf" standard errors did fix my error. I was using 3 different GWASs than the wiki example ones... The specific GWAS that had "inf" values for SE had these "Inf" entries because I had converted one of the Neale Lab UKbioboank linear GWAS (for a binary phenotype) to a logistic odds ratio using LMOR (http://cnsgenomics.com/shiny/LMOR/).

Cheers,
Chris
